definition: Dysautonomia is a disorder of the autonomic nervous system that can affect either the sympathetic or parasympathetic system, and it may be acute or long-lasting. It can occur on its own, from degeneration in the central nervous system, or secondarily with conditions such as diabetes or alcoholism; chronic cases often worsen over time and tend to have a poor outlook.
